text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
From here on, the days of racing through the Twinkle Series
with my partner Umamusume would begin.
The name of the girl who walks alongside me is—

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
I'm Vivlos!
Nice to meetcha, Trainie♡

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
I'll do my best aiming for Dubai,
the land of sparkling celebrities♪

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
So Trainer-chi,
praise me a whole buuunch for working so hard♡

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, our challenge for the Twinkle Series
with <chrname> began!
